units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 33a:14">Kidd. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>באידך ג׳</he> on the other side (of the river); <cite ref="Eruvin 16b:17">Erub. 16ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 110a:1">Sabb. 110ᵃ</cite> <he>בההוא ג׳ וכ׳</he> in a certain neighborhood of &c.—
Koh. R. to VII, 9 when the kettle boils over, על גיסיה שפיך it pours over its own sides (wrath will hurt none but the man himself); a. fr.—Trnsf. way, manner.
<cite ref="Gittin 67b:4">Gitt. 67ᵇ</cite> some argue <he>להאי ג׳ וכ׳</he> one way and some the other way; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Niddah 66a:39">Nidd. 66ᵃ</cite> [read:] <he>לא תגלי … דכי היכי דתהוו עליך להן ג׳ וכ׳</he> (v. Ar. ed. Koh. s. v. <he>דם</he> IV, 75<sup>2</sup>) do not tell thy friends, for as they wondered over thee on the one side (over thy bad luck), they may wonder on the other side (over thy good fortune, and bewitch it). [<cite ref="Chullin 17b">Ḥull. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>אתרי גִיסָנֵי</he>, Sh’eltoth d’R. Aḥai 92, ed. <he>אתלת רוחתא</he>.]
